industry.why: Neutral, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Jefferies' desk (17 Oct) names utilities with staples as 'pricing-power defensives' and utilities led the US week, which is the defensive case; against it, utilities are the classic bond proxy, the Fed hikes in December and no European power price was read. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, D prior. Integrated generators and regulated networks stay C at sector level, renewable generators D.

sector.why: Neutral, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): the defensive case strengthened at the level (Jefferies' desk favours utilities as pricing-power defensives; utilities led the US week) and the bond-proxy case is unchanged (December hike priced); the standing hypothesis that owners of existing hydro and nuclear capacity gain as the energy shock reaches power prices is still a hypothesis, because no European power price was read for a third week. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: C now, C prior. Five Pool names (Fortum Sell-side A, Technical A, TSR/Valuation F; Endesa; PGE; Public Power; Electrica). Moves to B on a European power-price reading that supports the generators.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged on this week's reading. Goldman Sachs (16 Oct) has French spreads at decade highs with tentative spillover to Italy and judges France's fiscal challenge 'harder now than in 2011-15'; the premium in basis points was not read, so the reversal conditions (back to D under 120 basis points, to C under 100) could not be tested and are plainly not met at a decade high. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country; no live holding is French-listed. Counter-case unchanged: a country letter is a blunt tool on 110 stocks and lands on French-listed global businesses (TotalEnergies, whose memo exposures lift its Thematic Fit/Momentum by two grades through the stock layer; Soitec; Sopra Steria; Alten) as hard as on domestic banks and property; and Goldman's own judgement is that disorderly escalation is less likely than in 2011-15.
